main_text.p: m. Diversa genera, Heterogenea: Lev.19.19. Aben Esra notat, שְׁנֵי מִינִים כִּלְאַיִם sunt dua diversa species quæ inter se miscentur. Legitur & Deut.22.9.
כֶּלֶב m. Canis, Exod.11.7. Plural. כְּלָבִים Canes, Jes.56.10. Constr. עִם כַּלְבֵּי צֹאנִי Cum canibus gregis mei, Job.30.1.
כְּלוּב קִיץ m. Canistrum, Fiscus, Corbis, Cavea: Canistrum æstivorum fructuum, Amos 8.1. כִּכְלוּב[?] Sicut cavea plena avibus, Jer.5.25.

כָּלָה Consumi, Deficere; Absolvi, Perfici, Finiri: Et ex usu Chaldaico, Confidere, Sperare, Anxiè exspectare, quomodo in Targum respondet Hebraeis Verbis בָּטַח & יָחַל. Præter. נִכְסְפָה גַּם כְּלָתָה נַפְשִׁי Desiderat & anxiè exspectat, aut confidit anima mea, Psal. 84.v.3. vel, Deficit, Consumitur desiderio: כָּלְתָה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ Anxiè exspectat salutem tuam anima mea, Ps.119.81. Sic mox in Pihel: כִּלִּינוּ Consumimur, Psal.90.7. Infinit. עַד לְכַלּוֹת Usq; ad absolvi, donec absolvatur, 1.Paral.28. v.20. Pih. כִּלָּה Absolvit, Complevit, Perfecit, Finivit, Consummavit, Consumpsit: Solicitè expetivit, Anxiè expectavit, ut antè. Præter. כִּלִּיתִי Consumpsi, Num. 25.11. Partic. מְכַלָּה Consumpturus, Jerem.14.12. Fut. וַתִּכֶל דָּוִד Et solicitè expetivit David rex, 2.Sam.13. v.39. per Apocopam pro תִּכְלָה, quod fœmininum, & subintelligitur נֶפֶשׁ Anima, ut Chaldæus complet. Pyh.Præt. כָּלוּ Absolutæ sunt, Finiuntur, Psal.7.20. וַיְכֻלּוּ Et perfecti sunt, Gen.2.1.
כְּלֵאָה[?] m. Consumptus, Deficiens: Plural. Fœminin. כְּלוֹת Deficientes, Deut.28.32.
כְּלָאָה f. Consumptio, Consummatio: Jesa. 28. 22. Plural. כְּלוֹת ut in præcedenti voce.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks in the headwords are small on the scan; כִּכְלוּב, כְּלֵאָה and the Amos vowel in קִיץ are doubtful and marked [?]. Printed "Aben Esra" and "dua" left as printed. Two headwords (כְּלָאָה, כְּלֵאָה) are hard to tell apart at this resolution. Printing forms such as "Pih." and "Pyh." are kept as printed.
